heading: Today
text: Some patchy morning fog. Clouds, with a few breaks of sun.  A chance of showers in MA, southeast VT into southern NH, rain possible in the afternoon.  Highs in the 60s.  Light winds, mainly north 5 to 10 mph.

heading: Tonight
text: Mostly cloudy.  A chance of showers east of the Green Mountains, with periods of rain through the CT Valley and NH.  Lows in the 40s, near 50 far south.  Winds north to northwest up to 10 mph, diminishing to light overnight.

heading: Saturday
text: Cloudy, with morning showers east ending.  Showers developing in NY, spreading east during the afternoon.  Highs in the 50s, closer to 60 south.  Winds becoming northeast near 10 mph.
